search_single_scan: run a sequential block-by-block IVF search on a faiss index with configurable block size
test_search_with_parameters: test faiss IVF search using IVFSearchParameters to override nprobe at query time
test_range_search_with_parameters: test faiss IVF range search using IVFSearchParameters to override nprobe at query time
test_shard_ivf_index_centroids: test sharding an IVF index by centroids into multiple shard files with custom or default sharding
test_shard_binary_ivf_index_centroids: test sharding a binary IVF index by centroids into multiple shard files with custom or default sharding
